scope: Read-only audit of preserved original paper outputs; no model calls or original outcome edits.
interpretation: BaseAgent constructs a new client context every turn (base.py:335); OpenAIClient.init_context creates only system/user messages (openai_client.py:69-83), and generate_response sends no previous_response_id. Revocation removes prior private-board text from the next model input; retaining raw board records is not persistent model memory.
All held-out history and memoryless controller pairs realize the same feedback schedule. Their outcome differences cannot identify a benefit from historical controller state.

Each audited original-feedback held-out agent makes one successful irreversible assignment, after which BaseAgent stops the generation loop (base.py:370-372). The resulting actor score is never input to a later same-episode model call by that actor. Effects can operate through later recipients only.

Original/suppressed full-episode arms do not share planning histories. First choices differ before any feedback is available, quantifying substantial stochastic prefix variation. Task-seed matching alone is not exact-history matching.
Native tasks_done counts feasible claims including duplicate tasks (jira_ticket_env.py:247-267). Preserve native reward, but distinguish feasible assignment rate from unique task completion.
